title: Marketing Lead - B2B Demand Generation & Growth (m/w/d) - Remote
description: Über uns ZEP ist eine cloudbasierte Software für Projektcontrolling – von der Projektzeiterfassung über Abwesenheitsverwaltung bis zur Abrechnung. Mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen, vor allem projektorientierte Dienstleister wie Beratungen, IT- und Engineering-Unternehmen, arbeiten bereits mit ZEP. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2000 sind wir inhabergeführt und kontinuierlich gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und noch mehr Unternehmen von ZEP überzeugen. Als Marketing Lead entwickelst du die passenden Ideen und Maßnahmen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und unser Wachstum aktiv voranzutreiben. Du willst Marketing nicht nur umsetzen, sondern verantworten – mit klaren Pipeline-Zielen, eigenem Budget und einem Team, das du weiterentwickelst? Als Marketing Lead bei ZEP übernimmst du die Ergebnisverantwortung für unser Marketing und die daraus entstehende Pipeline. Du führst das Marketingteam sowie unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, steuerst das Marketingbudget und greifst aktiv ein, wenn Zahlen vom Plan abweichen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität dort, wo es darauf ankommt. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest unsere Pipeline-Ziele und das Marketingbudget und steuerst aktiv gegen, wenn Zahlen abweichen. Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung, schärfst Positionierung und Messaging für unsere B2B-Zielgruppen und leitest daraus Ziele und Prioritäten ab. Du führst das Marketingteam, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Teammitglieder fachlich und persönlich weiter. Du steuerst und forderst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister – insbesondere im Paid-Bereich (z. B. Google Ads, Paid Social) – mit klaren Zielen und Briefings und misst sie an ihren Ergebnissen. Du baust Demand Generation über mehrere Kanäle auf, nicht nur über Paid. Du verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb die Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Sales. Du sorgst für sauberes Tracking und Attribution über den gesamten Funnel. Du wertest Kampagnen, Funnel und Conversion Rates aus – wenn nötig selbst in HubSpot und im Tracking – und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab. Du entwickelst SEO und die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchen (AI Search) als wachsenden Kanal weiter. Du entwickelst unsere Website weiter und holst mehr Leads aus dem vorhandenen Traffic. Deine Voraussetzungen Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit, mit Schwerpunkt Demand Generation. Du hast nachweislich Pipeline- oder Umsatzziele erreicht und hattest Budgetverantwortung. Du hast bereits Führungserfahrung gesammelt: Du hast ein Marketingteam geführt, Prioritäten gesetzt und Mitarbeitende weiterentwickelt. Du hast Erfahrung darin, Agenturen und Dienstleister zu steuern und fachlich zu fordern. Du kennst dich mit Performance Marketing (Google Ads, Paid Social) so gut aus, dass du Agenturen auf Augenhöhe führst. Du bist sicher in Analyse, Tracking und Attribution; idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit HubSpot. Du setzt KI selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit ein und weißt, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt. Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher verständigen. Deine Benefits 30 Tage Urlaub und unbefristete Arbeitsverträge Remote First Company – Arbeite innerhalb Deutschlands von wo du möchtest! Unterstützung bei der Home-Office Einrichtung Chancen, Freiheiten und Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines Startups verbunden mit der Sicherheit eines seit über 20 Jahren etablierten Unternehmens im Mittelstand. raw.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
raw.description:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar.

What you will achieve in your first year

  • You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview.

  • You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers.

  • You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like

  • The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations.

  • You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them.

  • You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile, a process or a decision is not right. We want you to.

What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth tech company, hiring software engineers.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Technical fluency: you understand modern tech stacks and roles (full-stack, backend, AI/ML, platform) well enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers.

  • Proven technical sourcing skills across LinkedIn, GitHub and tech communities, including Boolean and X-ray searches.

  • Structured assessment: you have built interview loops with engineering teams and keep them fair, fast and consistent.

  • Strong closing skills: you win engineers against competing offers, including from big tech and AI companies.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • German language skills.

  • Experience hiring AI/ML engineers.

  • Experience with cross-border hiring in Europe, including Employer of Record set-ups.

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.

What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25 vacation days per year, rising by one day for each year with Cosuno up to a maximum of 28 days. On top of that, 24 and 31 December are always off.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • Top equipment: a new MacBook Air.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.

Our hiring process (max. 4 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Live Case Study with one of our Engineers, 60 minutes.

  3. Career deep-dive with Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and Carmen Pölking (Head of Product), followed by a conversation about our culture and values with Vivien Littmann (People Lead), 60 minutes in total.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 1 or 2 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 4 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Compensation: €70K – €90K • Plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

You’re willing to roll your sleeves up and go deep with prospective customers on their functional and technical needs, partnering with our sales, product and climate science teams along the way. You may be a carbon accounting aficionado or you may have never worked in climate before but have a passion for the subject; either way, you have a knack for quickly learning new, complex topics and distilling them for others. Considered a “very nice to have” if you: Have a background in corporate climate programs or carbon accounting Have policy experience, especially in climate/sustainability/corporate reporting This role might include up to 25% travel. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung. Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht. Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter. Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab. Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden. Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System. Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Prozesse, Ergebnisse und die Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Und das Beste: Du wirst Schritt für Schritt eingearbeitet und erhältst regelmäßige Trainings, damit du sicher, professionell und erfolgreich in deine Rolle hineinwächst. Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen und kannst durch deine offene, empathische Art schnell Vertrauen aufbauen. Du bringst Interesse an Beauty, Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ mit. Du arbeitest gerne vertriebsorientiert und hast Spaß daran, Kund*innen zu beraten, zu überzeugen und zum Abschluss zu begleiten. Du kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend – am Telefon, im persönlichen Gespräch und im Team. Du bist zuverlässig, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Kontakten und Terminen den Überblick. Du arbeitest zielorientiert, motiviert und hast Lust, dich fachlich sowie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. raw.description:
Kurzüberblick

  • Position: Kalkulator TGA / HLKS (Heizung, Lüftung, Klima, Sanitär) (m/w/d)

  • Arbeitgeber: Führender Gesamtdienstleister der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung, Teil einer führenden Unternehmensgruppe

  • Standort: München West, hybrid. Alternativ kommen Sie aus den Regionen Augsburg, Weilheim, Fürstenfeldbruck, Ammersee, Starnberg, Dachau

  • Anstellung: Vollzeit, unbefristet

  • Gehalt: 65.000 bis 84.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung

  • Homeoffice: 2 Tage pro Woche mobiles Arbeiten

  • Urlaub: 30 Tage

  • Berufserfahrung: mehrjährige Erfahrung in der HLKS-Kalkulation

  • Benefits: betriebliche Krankenversicherung, JobRad, Fitnessangebot, Corporate Benefits, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Poolfahrzeuge

  • Start: ab sofort

Das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant plant, baut und betreibt sämtliche TGA-Gewerke aus einer Hand und realisiert bundesweit anspruchsvolle Projekte für Industrie, Pharma, Logistik und Energie. Als Teil einer der führenden Unternehmensgruppen der Elektro- und Gebäudetechnik verbindet er die Sicherheit eines starken Verbunds mit der Beweglichkeit eines Mittelständlers.

Die Kultur

Kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien und ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Kalkulation, Projektabwicklung und eigene Montage arbeiten Hand in Hand, und gute Ideen werden hier nicht verwaltet, sondern umgesetzt.

Der Arbeitgeber

Hier steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt: mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, gezielter Weiterbildung und klaren Entwicklungswegen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie prüfen und bewerten Ausschreibungs- und Angebotsunterlagen öffentlicher und privater Auftraggeber umfassend

  • Sie selektieren eingehende Anfragen nach Wirtschaftlichkeit und Machbarkeit

  • Sie erstellen digitale Angebots- und Nachtragskalkulationen für Heizung, Klima, Lüftung, Kälte und Sanitär

  • Sie berechnen belegte Herstellkosten inklusive Lohnanteilen

  • Sie ermitteln Kalkulationsgrundlagen und entwickeln Kalkulationsdaten und Kennzahlen weiter

  • Sie holen Angebote von Nachunternehmern und Lieferanten ein, bewerten sie, verfolgen sie nach und erstellen Preisspiegel

  • Sie bearbeiten Leistungsverzeichnisse und entwickeln gemeinsam mit der Projektabwicklung technische Alternativen und Sondervorschläge

  • Sie klären technische Details und Vertragsmodalitäten mit den Projektverantwortlichen

  • Sie identifizieren und bewerten technische, terminliche und vertragliche Risiken

  • Sie führen Angebotsabschluss- und Vergabegespräche und übergeben Projekte strukturiert an die Abwicklung

  • Bei entsprechender Erfahrung leiten Sie junge Kalkulatoren fachlich an und gestalten Standards sowie die Digitalisierung der Kalkulation mit

Ihr Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Angebotskalkulation von HLKS-Gewerken, idealerweise bei einem ausführenden TGA-Unternehmen oder Anlagenbauer

  • Sicherheit in der Kalkulation von Lohn- und Montagezeiten sowie belegten Herstellkosten

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, gerne mit Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker oder Meister SHK / Heizungs- und Lüftungsbau

  • Alternativ ein Studium der Versorgungstechnik / TGA

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der VOB/A und VOB/B, von Leistungsverzeichnissen und im Nachtragsmanagement

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Kalkulationssoftware sowie MS Office, insbesondere Excel

  • Verhandlungssicheres Auftreten, kaufmännisches Denken und eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit GAEB-Schnittstellen sowie mit Industrie-, Pharma-, Logistik- oder Großanlagenprojekten

Darum lohnt sich der Wechsel

  • Schlüsselrolle mit Wirkung: Ihre Kalkulation entscheidet über Auftragsgewinn und Projekterfolg, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsleitung

  • Echte Karriereperspektive: Durch Wachstum und Nachfolge können Sie Verantwortung für weitere Niederlassungen übernehmen und sich in eine Führungsposition entwickeln

  • Projekte mit Anspruch: Industrie, Pharma und Großanlagen statt Standard-Wohnungsbau

  • Kalkulation mit Praxisbezug: eigene Montage und direkte Rückkopplung aus der Ausführung

  • Attraktives Gehalt: 65.000 bis 84.000 Euro im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung

  • Flexibilität: 2 Tage mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche, flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Gründlicher Start: strukturierte Einarbeitung über rund 6 Monate mit festem Ansprechpartner

  • Vorsorge und Extras: betriebliche Krankenversicherung, JobRad, Fitnessangebot, Corporate Benefits, Poolfahrzeuge für Außentermine

  • Sicherheit: unbefristete Anstellung in einer wachstumsstarken Unternehmensgruppe

Interesse?

raw.description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

  • Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

  • Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

  • Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

  • Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

  • Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

  • Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

  • Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

  • Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

  • Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

  • Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

  • Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

  • Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

  • A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

  • To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

  • You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

  • You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

  • You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

  • You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

  • You are comfortable with English as a working language

  • You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

  1. First Call A short chat with one of our founders. We'll get to know your background and answer any questions you have about Anori Tech. 30 min

  2. Deep Dive with Case Study (on-site) A meeting with Stefan, our CTO. We want to understand how you work and talk through your past projects. The meeting also includes a small case study, and we will send you some context information for it beforehand. 2 - 3 hours

  3. Meet the Team (on-site) Time to meet your future colleagues! In this meeting we get to know each other. This is also the time to discuss final details like salary. 1 - 2 hours

The on-site meetings will be at our lab at the Bahrenfeld Startup Lab: Luruper Hauptstraße 1, 22547 Altona

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

raw.title: Senior Embedded Rust Firmware Engineer
raw.description:
About the Role

Our firmware team is growing, and we are looking for a senior engineer to take the lead on core parts of it. You'll own major parts of the embedded Rust firmware at the heart of the BMS, deliver features end to end on your own and help shape how the firmware is built. Together with Stefan, our CTO, and our embedded Rust engineer, you'll take on architecture decisions and code reviews and help take us from a tested prototype to a fully certified product. The technology is proven, the funding is secured, and the foundations you set now will define how every future Anori BMS works.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Own, design, implement and ship firmware features for the BMS, from requirement to verified release

  • Extend our middleware and independent modules into one real-time system: their control and data flow, scheduling and how they stay predictable under load

  • Mentor other engineers on the team, lead code reviews and raise the bar for code quality across the team

  • Set and evolve the engineering practices that keep the firmware trustworthy: testing, CI/CD, HiL, coverage and end-to-end requirements traceability

  • Debug and trace on real hardware across ARM and RISC-V cores, down to interrupt priorities, the memory map and timing of individual functions

What You Bring

Must have

  • Several years of production Rust on embedded targets (no_std), including features you designed and shipped yourself

  • Experience making, documenting and defending architecture trade-offs for embedded systems

  • A quality mindset: hands-on test experience, CI and coverage as everyday tools, and code reviews with constructive feedback.

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Deep embedded experience incl. async Rust on embedded targets, down to the executor: futures, wakers, pinning

  • Architecture of multicore and multi-controller systems: the partition of work, data and timing across cores and controllers

  • Hands-on debugging and tracing on ARM and RISC-V

  • Knowledge of various communication protocols and stacks: CAN, LIN, BLE, LTE modems

  • Basic hardware skills: reading schematics, working with an oscilloscope, board bring-up, debugging

Nice to have

  • Formal methods for embedded software: model checking, or a proof of a scheduling or memory property

  • A background in safety-critical (IEC 61508, ISO 26262, …) and battery systems

  • Comfortable implementing numerical algorithms (filtering, state estimation) on constrained hardware

  • Experience mentoring other engineers

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you see yourself growing into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

  • Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

  • Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

  • A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

  • To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

  • You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

  • You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

  • You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

  • You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

  • You are comfortable with English as a working language

  • You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

1. First Call A short chat with one of our founders. We'll get to know your background and answer any questions you have about Anori Tech. 30 min

2. Deep Dive with Case Study (on-site) A meeting with Stefan, our CTO. We want to understand how you work and talk through your past projects. The meeting also includes a small case study, and we will send you some context information for it beforehand. 2 - 3 hours

3. Meet the Team (on-site)Time to meet your future colleagues! In this meeting we get to know each other. This is also the time to discuss final details like salary. 1 - 2 hours

🏬 The on-site meetings will be at our lab at the Bahrenfeld Startup Lab: Luruper Hauptstraße 1, 22547 Altona

Qualifikation:

  • Studium im Bereich Übersetzen, Dolmetschen, Sprachwissenschaften oder vergleichbare Fachrichtung

Benefits

title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
description: Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen. Warum diese Rolle? Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält. • Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft. • Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten. • Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben • Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung. • Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein. • Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben. • Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen. • Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen. • Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt. Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt. Das bringen Sie mit • Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium • Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0 • Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe • Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53) • Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA Das erwartet Sie • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung Interesse? description: Über uns INNOFLEET ist ein spezialisierter Fahrzeugdienstleister, der für Unternehmen der Automobilindustrie Fahrzeuge in jeder angeforderten Spezifikation für kurz- und langfristige Einsätze im In- und Ausland beschafft und bereitstellt. Die Fahrzeuge kommen insbesondere bei Wettbewerbsvergleichen (Benchmarks), Technologieanalysen, Workshops, Car-Clinics sowie Produktschulungen zum Einsatz. Wo bestimmte Fahrzeugmodelle oder spezifische Ausstattungen kurzfristig benötigt werden, verantworten wir den gesamten Prozess – von der weltweiten Marktrecherche über die Beschaffung bis zur termingerechten Bereitstellung und Rückgabe. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit schlanken Strukturen, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem hohen Anspruch an Verbindlichkeit und Präzision. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Automobilhersteller (OEMs), Unternehmen der Zulieferindustrie, Ingenieurbüros, Marktforschungsinstitute sowie spezialisierte Agenturen. Für die operative Steuerung und den weiteren Ausbau unserer Projekte suchen wir ab sofort einen Automotive-Projektmanager (m/w/d). Ihr Verantwortungsbereich Sie prüfen eingehende Kundenanfragen, recherchieren die benötigten Fahrzeuge am nationalen wie internationalen Markt, führen Preisverhandlungen und kaufen Fahrzeuge sowie notwendige Fremdleistungen ein. Sie kalkulieren die Projekte wirtschaftlich durch und erstellen verbindliche Angebote für unsere Kunden. Sie planen und begleiten die komplette Vor- und Nachbereitung der Einsätze – von der Organisation der Fahrzeugübernahmen und -rückgaben bis hin zur Abwicklung im Schadensfall. Die entscheidenden Maschinen dafür entwickeln wir selbst, vom ersten Konzept bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Du bringst sie zum Laufen: vom ersten verdrahteten Schaltschrank bis zur Maschine, die zuverlässig produziert. Und das bei uns in der Werkstatt, nicht auf Montage irgendwo in der Welt. Abends bist du zu Hause.

Über uns

Die Personalized Nutrition Systems GmbH betreibt mit suppify eine Plattform, über die Unternehmen in kurzer Zeit eigene Marken für Nahrungsergänzungsmittel entwickeln und auf den Markt bringen. Software und Produktionstechnik kommen bei uns aus einer Hand. Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust Schaltschränke auf, prüfst sie und nimmst sie in Betrieb

  • Du bringst Servoantriebe, Sensorik und Aktorik an neuen Maschinen zum Laufen

  • Du spielst Steuerungsprogramme auf, die bei uns die KI schreibt, testest sie an der echten Maschine und findest heraus, was noch nicht passt

  • Du suchst Fehler systematisch, elektrisch wie mechanisch, und behebst sie

  • Du prüfst Sicherheitsfunktionen wie Not-Halt und Schutztüren

  • Du fährst Testläufe, wertest die Ergebnisse aus und gibst sie an die Konstruktion zurück

  • Bei Schaltplänen, Fehlersuche und Dokumentation unterstützt dich KI an jedem Arbeitsplatz

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatroniker oder Industrieelektriker (m/w/d) und idealerweise eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, oder du hast Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder Automatisierungstechnik studiert (Ingenieur)

  • Du packst gern selbst an und arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert

  • Du hast Lust, mit KI zu arbeiten; Erfahrung damit brauchst du nicht

Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

  • Keine Montagereisen: Du arbeitest an unserem Standort und bist abends zu Hause

title: Founding Principal Engineer (m/f/d)
description: About us Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. Energie tanken: Kalte und warme Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir kostenlos zur Verfügung. Gemeinschaft, die trägt: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und echten Zusammenhalt. Mitgestalten statt nur mitarbeiten: Bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv unsere gemeinsame Zukunft. description: Karriereservice,de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Zur kreativen Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir Dich – in unserem Büro Kaarst, hybrid oder vollständig remote. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Erstellung und Gestaltung ansprechender Präsentationen. Darüber hinaus wirkst Du an Blogartikeln sowie weiteren Marketing- und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen mit und bringst eigene Ideen für unseren Außenauftritt ein. Start & Dauer: Idealerweise startest Du im November oder Dezember und unterstützt uns für etwa drei Monate. Den genauen Zeitraum stimmen wir gerne gemeinsam mit Dir ab. Aufgaben Freue Dich auf die Arbeit in einem modernen und offenen Beratungsunternehmen. Bei uns bist Du von Anfang an mittendrin statt nur dabei und gestaltest aktiv mit. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Raum für eigene Ideen und Einblicke in unseren Beratungsalltag: Du gestaltest Präsentationen und Schulungsunterlagen rund um Karriere, Bewerbung, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und Führung und bringst Inhalte verständlich und visuell ansprechend auf den Punkt. Du wirkst an Blogartikeln und weiteren Texten mit: Du recherchierst spannende Themen, entwickelst Ideen und unterstützt uns beim Schreiben und Überarbeiten. Du unterstützt unseren digitalen Auftritt mit Beiträgen, Grafiken und kreativen Konzepten für unsere Webseite und Social-Media-Kanäle wie LinkedIn und Instagram. Du gestaltest weitere Marketingmaterialien mit , wie beispielsweise die Vorstellung unserer Beratungs- und Trainingsangebote. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Beraterteam und anderen Werkstudierenden zusammen , tauschst Ideen aus und setzt gemeinsame Projekte um. Du erhältst Einblicke in unser Unternehmen und unsere Arbeitsweise: Du lernst unterschiedliche Beratungs- und Trainingsangebote kennen und erfährst, wie wir Menschen bei ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung begleiten. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für kleinere Projekte, passend zu Deinen Interessen und Stärken. Qualifikation Du studierst beispielsweise BWL mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign oder ein vergleichbares Fach. Entscheidend sind für uns Dein Interesse an Marketing und Kommunikation sowie Deine Freude daran, Inhalte und Ideen ansprechend aufzubereiten. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit: Du hast ein Gespür für Gestaltung und Freude daran, Präsentationen, Grafiken und andere Materialien übersichtlich und ansprechend zu gestalten. Du formulierst klar und verständlich und hast Spaß daran, Texte zu entwickeln, zu überarbeiten und auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen abzustimmen. Du interessierst Dich für Karriere, Arbeitswelt und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Themen ein. Du bist digital affin: Erste Erfahrungen mit PowerPoint, Canva oder vergleichbaren Gestaltungsprogrammen sind willkommen. Kenntnisse in Social Media oder der Webseitenpflege sind ein zusätzliches Plus. Du bist neugierig auf die Möglichkeiten von KI und möchtest sie für Recherche, Texte und Gestaltung sinnvoll einsetzen. Erste Erfahrungen sind willkommen. Vieles kannst Du auch bei uns lernen. Du arbeitest zuverlässig und zunehmend eigenständig , achtest auf Details und fragst nach, wenn Du Unterstützung brauchst. Du hast Lust auf Zusammenarbeit , tauschst Dich gerne mit unserem Beraterteam und anderen Werkstudierenden aus und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass Du Lust hast, Neues auszuprobieren, dazuzulernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas umzusetzen. Benefits Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen! Abwechslung & Einblicke: Du probierst Dich aus und lernst unseren Beratungs- und Trainingsalltag kennen. Kreativer Freiraum: Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Du kannst neue Formate entwickeln und Deine Stärken einbringen. Flexibilität & Vertrauen: Arbeite in unserem Büro in Kaarst, hybrid oder vollständig remote – mit flexiblen Zeiten, die zu Deiner Lebenssituation passen. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Dich erwartet ein offenes Team mit persönlichem Austausch, Humor und gegenseitiger Unterstützung. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well.</p> <p>You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling.</p> <p>You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business.</p> <h3><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Owning and scaling paid social performance globally</strong>, ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms.</li> <li><strong>Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets</strong>, using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth.</li> <li><strong>Building an AI-enabled paid social team</strong>, deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way.</li> <li><strong>Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows</strong>, using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks.</li> <li><strong>Using AI and automation across the account</strong>, from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work.</li> <li><strong>Developing and executing the paid social roadmap</strong>, identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms.</li> <li><strong>Driving a full-funnel approach</strong>, from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights.</li> <li><strong>Collaborating with cross-functional teams</strong> (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives.</li> <li><strong>Championing attribution and measurement</strong>, ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation.</li> <li><strong>Leading creative strategy</strong>, working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance.</li> <li><strong>Staying ahead of industry changes</strong>, including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), <strong>AI-driven platform updates</strong>, and new advertising solutions.</li> <li><strong>Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team</strong>, shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You’ll be a great fit if:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social.</li> <li>You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook &amp; Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices.</li> <li>You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms.</li> <li>You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making.</li> <li>You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.).</li> <li>You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation.</li> <li>You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it.</li> <li>You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services.</li> <li>You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels.</li> <li>You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation.</li> <li>You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories.</li> <li>You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment.</li> <li>You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals.</li> <li>Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll get in return:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements.</li> <li>25 days holiday + bank holidays.</li> <li>Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being.</li> <li>£1,000 L&amp;D budget per year, plus up to three L&amp;D paid days off.</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave.</li> <li>Work abroad for up to 90 days a year.</li> <li>Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tidean Ways of Working</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)</li> <li><strong>Exceptional project management skills</strong>, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>Creative collaborator: </strong>Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.</li> <li><strong>Self-starter attitude</strong>: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get in return</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&amp;D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide&nbsp;</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements</li> <li>Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. description: <div class="flex max-w-full flex-col grow"> <div class="min-h-8 text-message relative flex w-full flex-col items-end gap-2 text-start break-words whitespace-normal [.text-message+&amp;]:mt-1" data-message-author-role="assistant" data-message-id="f299b106-f5ab-4bce-90c8-cf18e84f4803" data-message-model-slug="gpt-5-2-thinking"> <div class="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden first:pt-[1px]"> <div class="markdown prose dark:prose-invert w-full break-words dark markdown-new-styling"> <h2 style="text-align: center;"><em><strong>Software Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom</strong></em></h2> <h3 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43">&nbsp;</h3> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43">&nbsp;</h4> <p data-start="45" data-end="169"><em><strong>Location:</strong> </em>Remote (UK)<br><em><strong>Type of contract:</strong> </em>Freelance<br><em><strong>Hourly Rate:</strong> </em>£19 (pay based on actual study time)</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43"><em>About Prolific</em></h4> <p data-start="45" data-end="169">Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.</p> <p data-start="171" data-end="344">Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.</p> <p><em><strong>The Role</strong></em><strong><br></strong>Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting software engineers and developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a software engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.</p> <p>The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.</p> <p><em><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant</li> <li>Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective</li> <li>Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Residence in the UK</li> <li>Fluent English</li> <li>A device with a working microphone</li> <li>No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Why join this project?</strong></em><strong><br></strong>This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.</p> <p><em>Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.</em></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="2302" data-end="2362"><em>Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant</em></h4> <p data-start="2364" data-end="2679">Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.</p> <p data-start="2681" data-end="2975">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</p> <p data-start="2977" data-end="3349">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3351" data-end="3391"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></h4> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3393" data-end="3402"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website</a></p> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3404" data-end="3413"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3415" data-end="3435"><em>Privacy Statement</em></h4> <p data-start="3437" data-end="3863" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/Policy-Privacy-Notice-for-Candidates-f94a136a67544388b4888bc436451b57">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting data scientists based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a data scientist. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.</p> <p>The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.</p> <p><em><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant</li> <li>Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective</li> <li>Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Residence in the UK</li> <li>Fluent English</li> <li>A device with a working microphone</li> <li>No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Why join this project?</strong></em><strong><br></strong>This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.</p> <p><em>Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.</em></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="2302" data-end="2362"><em>Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant</em></h4> <p data-start="2364" data-end="2679">Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.</p> <p data-start="2681" data-end="2975">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</p> <p data-start="2977" data-end="3349">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3351" data-end="3391"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></h4> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3393" data-end="3402"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website</a></p> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3404" data-end="3413"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3415" data-end="3435"><em>Privacy Statement</em></h4> <p data-start="3437" data-end="3863" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/Policy-Privacy-Notice-for-Candidates-f94a136a67544388b4888bc436451b57">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.</p> <p>Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s (&amp; Doordash’s) growth at scale.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You’ll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.</p> <h3>What You’ll Be Doing</h3> <p>You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.</p> <p>These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.</p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.</li> <li>Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.</li> <li>Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.</li> <li>Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.</li> <li>Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.</li> <li>Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.</li> <li>Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3>What You’ll Need to Thrive</h3> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.</li> <li>Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.</li> <li>Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.</li> <li>Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.</li> <li>Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.</li> <li>A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.</li> <li>Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.</li> <li>Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.</li> <li>Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.</li> <li>Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.</li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Us?</h3> <p>At Deliveroo (Doordash), you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.</p> <p>Working here you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.</li> <li>🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.</li> <li>🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.</li> <li>🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</li> <li>💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</li> </ul> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our <a href="https://deliveroo.engineering/">Tech Blog</a>.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3–4 stages. Explore our <a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/interview-guide-for-engineers/">Engineering Interview Guide</a> to help you feel confident at each stage.</p> <h3><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></h3> <p>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-LW1</p> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;">&nbsp;</div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Technology practice are looking for an experienced Architecture Manager to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In Technology, we help clients define, drive and deliver technology-led change. We have deep experience in the strategy, design, delivery and assurance of large-scale transformation across financial services, energy, commodities, utilities, telecoms and government. Our people become trusted advisors, independent of any technology provider, and deliver real value for our clients.</p> <p>AI is changing how organisations work, compete and invest, and it’s changing architecture with it. Our clients need architects who can cut through the hype, turn ambition into practical action and create value without losing control of cost, risk or complexity.</p> <p>In our Architecture practice we bring the right balance of innovation, pace and control to technology-enabled change. We work on our clients’ most complex and highest-return challenges. Commodity or ivory-tower architecture isn’t where we play.</p> <p>As a Manager, you’ll lead architecture work, use AI to raise the pace and quality of what we deliver, and play an active part in growing our business. You’ll spot opportunities, shape compelling work and build relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Lead architecture that delivers real value</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead architecture work that turns strategy into practical change. That means owning architecture engagements and workstreams, shaping target architectures and roadmaps, and helping clients make better decisions about where to invest, what to simplify and how to manage risk.</p> <ul> <li>Lead engagements with clear ownership of scope, quality, outcomes and client relationships</li> <li>Help organisations improve their architecture functions, operating models and governance</li> <li>Communicate complex ideas clearly, from delivery teams through to CTOs and CIOs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Help clients navigate AI-enabled change</strong></p> <p>You’ll help clients move from interest in AI to safe, valuable adoption. We’ll look to you to cut through the noise, design for change and make sure AI-enabled solutions have the foundations they need: data, integration, security, identity, governance and clear ownership.</p> <ul> <li>Shape AI-ready architectures that balance innovation, pace and control</li> <li>Help clients move beyond disconnected pilots to reusable services, governed delivery and measurable value</li> <li>Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, option development and architecture artefacts, with strong quality assurance throughout</li> </ul> <p><strong>Create and convert commercial opportunities</strong></p> <p>You’ll play an active part in growing our business. That means spotting where we can help, shaping work that clients value and building the confidence to convert good conversations into deliverable opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Qualify opportunities through delivery, market insight and trusted relationships</li> <li>Shape proposals, statements of work, team shapes and commercial models with discipline</li> <li>Build architecture propositions that match our growth priorities and the challenges our clients face</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead people and build our capability</strong></p> <p>You’ll help build the kind of team people want to work in and clients want to work with. You’ll coach others, share what works and help us turn individual expertise into reusable capability across the practice.</p> <ul> <li>Lead mixed Baringa and client teams with clear expectations and a strong coaching mindset</li> <li>Coach colleagues on effective and responsible use of AI</li> <li>Help grow the practice through training, thought leadership, reusable assets and recruitment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading architecture work within complex technology-enabled change, with a strong delivery focus</li> <li>Experience in both enterprise and solution architecture, translating strategy into deliverable target architectures and roadmaps, and designing and assuring solutions to achieve it</li> <li>Broad experience across architecture domains (business, application, integration, data, infrastructure and security), with deep expertise in at least one</li> <li>Cloud experience across XaaS offerings, with knowledge of cloud-native services and how to use them in cloud and hybrid solutions</li> <li>A practical understanding of AI and the architecture considerations needed to adopt it safely and at scale. Hands-on AI design experience is a bonus, not a must</li> <li>Experience contributing to proposals, bids or account growth, and the commercial awareness to shape work that is valuable and deliverable</li> <li>The ability to take ownership of projects and teams, sell work and deliver results</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the complex in simple terms, concisely and with clarity</li> <li>Experience managing stakeholders from C-suite through to engineering, and a desire to build lasting relationships</li> <li>A collaborative style, real curiosity and a genuine interest in helping others grow&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits.
