The role

Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is a Gibraltar-based motor insurer regulated by the GFSC. We're growing, and as we do, we need to keep maturing how we operate as an insurer - proportionate to our size, with strong governance and a firm regulatory focus. This is a pivotal role to help us do that in a scalable and sustainable way.

Reporting into the Executive Director, Insurance Operations, you'll own ZIL's operations and lead insurer-focused projects across the business. You'll make sure we operate effectively as an insurer, bring more of our regulatory and project delivery in-house, and help us get ready for the bigger initiatives and partnerships ahead.

You'll also be involved in the management and oversight of our insurance partners and outsourced service providers, helping make sure the right operating rhythms are in place and contractual and regulatory requirements are met.

Here's what you'll be doing

  • Lead insurer-focused projects and regulatory workstreams, such as onboarding new insurance partners, operational resilience and GFSC deliverables.

  • Be hands-on in delivery. The expectation is to get things done and see them through to completion, not just oversee or track progress.

  • Take ownership of ZIL's operational resilience framework, as well as business continuity and disaster recovery, keeping them embedded and aligned to regulatory expectations.

  • Support ZIL's internal audit programme, coordinating reviews, working with the business on findings and making sure actions are closed out.

  • Further enhance ZIL's governance, strengthening our frameworks and controls, proactively documenting procedures and keeping policies up to date, clearly owned and on their review cycle.

  • Support the oversight of our outsourced service providers, including Zego MGA. This includes maintaining our outsourcing register, due diligence and exit plans for critical providers, keeping intragroup agreements and service schedules up to date, and producing SLA and KPI reporting for committees.

  • Support the management of our insurance partners, ensuring effective operating rhythms, strong relationships and that contractual requirements are met.

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The Role

We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows.

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code.

You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define how an AI-native company operates: help build Kernel’s internal playbook for using AI across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations

  • Make our GTM team more productive: automate the repetitive work in prospecting, account research, meeting prep and CRM hygiene, so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Build internal tools and workflows: use coding agents, APIs, automation platforms, no-code tools or lightweight code

  • Turn company data into operational leverage: connect and improve data across our systems, then put it to work in AI agents, proactive workflows and better decision-making

  • Put AI agents to work across Kernel: give teams agents with the right context, tools and guardrails so they can move faster without sacrificing judgement or reliability

  • Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, improve our GTM data and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

  • Level up the team: help colleagues become confident AI users, document what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working

Your First 6 Months

For your first six months, you’ll focus on our sales team. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. That means going deep on Salesforce and our GTM stack, and owning the RevOps workflows behind them. After that, you’ll bring the same approach to Marketing, Customer Success and Operations.

What You Bring

  • A track record of shipping: you’ve built tools, automations or AI workflows that people use every day, ideally inside a small, fast-moving startup. Around 2–5 years of experience is typical, but what you’ve built matters more than your years. Ex-founders welcome

  • Experience inside a high-growth startup, or building your own, is highly desirable

  • Curious about sales: you’re keen to learn how our BDRs and AEs work, and how Salesforce is set up, before you build for them

  • AI-tool obsessed: you are constantly testing new models, agents, MCPs and workflows, and you have the judgement to turn them into reliable systems that people actually adopt

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented, messy information into reliable workflows and create feedback loops that keep it trustworthy

  • Can’t unsee inefficiency: you see the company as a connected system; when you find a broken or unnecessarily manual process, your instinct is to understand it, build the fix and make sure it sticks

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer deep specialization over breadth: this role means switching between projects and teams, depending on business needs

  • Prefer steady-state work over project-based sprints: priorities will shift as the business evolves

  • Only want “strategic” work: you will personally build the tools, clean the data and fix the workflows

  • Need every task to be clearly scoped before starting: ambiguity and learning on the fly are constant

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

raw.title: Staff Engineer - Platform & Tooling
raw.description:
Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

About the role

Hi, I'm Thomas, VP Engineering at Atominvest. This is the hire I'm most excited about, so I wanted to tell you about it myself.

You'll own the platform our clients run on and build the AI development harness our engineers work in day to day. That work runs from infrastructure to application code, so we're looking for an experienced engineer with breadth across both, and depth in at least one. Together, it's what lets a small, lean team, working alongside AI agents, ship like a much bigger one.

 

By platform, we mean everything our product and our engineers stand on: infrastructure, security, test automation, developer experience, and the agent pipelines that run through all of them. It's a broad, hands-on role. You'll write infrastructure as code for a new service one day and address network vulnerabilities the next, then enhance our AI development harness and release a new feature, all within the same month.

 

You might be a platform engineer who loves shipping product, or a full-stack engineer who has run serious production infrastructure. Either works.

As deployments grow more complex, the team needs your depth in infrastructure and distributed systems. You'll strengthen the architecture and make the design decisions the platform will rest on for years. Those decisions should leave room to grow, because future products may bring much larger volumes of data than we handle today.

It has to stay dependable while we do it. Our software needs to be available around the clock, every day of the year, and data integrity is critical. Our clients use Atominvest to report to their own investors, so a wrong number matters as much as an outage. Security, reliability and audit-readiness matter too. If you enjoy getting those right without slowing everything else down, you'll find plenty of fun things to work on.

The machine that builds the product

We're becoming AI-native. Agents do more and more of the mechanical work of writing code, and engineers build the machine that builds the product: the architecture, the specs, the limits agents work within, and the evals that tell us whether their output is right.

I think that moves an engineer's leverage upstream. When code is cheap, the scarce things are judgement and understanding. Which problem is worth solving? What does good look like for the person using it? Is the output actually right? Did what we shipped help? The best engineers I've worked with always solved the end problem, with code as the medium. Now that's most of the job.

That's why product and user understanding sit at the centre of how we work. An engineer who knows our clients' workflows can point agents at the right problem and spot when the result is subtly wrong. Without that, agents just build the wrong thing faster.

Your part is the AI development harness that makes this safe. That means sandboxed environments with synthetic data, scoped and audited access to logs and alerts, and evals and validation gates in CI. It also means firm lines, enforced by tooling, that keep production deploys and secrets in human hands, and client data out of reach of development agents.

You'll also build the agent orchestration pipelines that run in three places: in how we build software, in AI workflows inside the product our clients use, and in the internal tools our implementation team uses to onboard and configure clients.

What you'll do

Build the machine that builds the product

Most of your time goes here.

  • Build our AI development harness. Self-service infrastructure, a reproducible development environment, and the sandboxes, guardrails and evals that let agents take on more of the work safely, with results we can measure.

  • Automate quality. Build the QA automation pipeline: automated tests, validation gates and release checks that give us confidence in every change, including the ones agents write.

  • Orchestrate agents across the business. Build pipelines that run agents reliably and safely in our product workflows and our internal implementation tools, not just in engineering.

Own the platform

  • Own our infrastructure. We're migrating to ECS. You'll strengthen our ECS architecture, see the move through in safe, reversible stages, bring every resource under infrastructure as code, and retire the old deployment model.

  • Build security into the platform. Tenant-scoped credentials, per-tenant secrets, least-privilege access, and the audit trail that SOC 2 and our clients' security teams expect.

  • Make production observable. Set up the monitoring, alerting and tracing we rely on, and build playbooks for on-call and incident response which is shared amongst the team.

Work across the stack

  • Make the application changes the harness needs, such as synthetic data, test hooks and the specs agents work from.

  • Ship product. Pick up application work in TypeScript and React alongside the team. Over time, you'll learn the codebase as well as the platform it runs on.

  • Grow the team around you. Write the design notes and runbooks, pair with and review the work of other engineers, and mentor those who want to grow into infrastructure, so the platform never depends on one person.

Your first six months

  • Get the first parts of "the machine" running, and show that they make the team faster without lowering quality.

  • At the moment all of our end to end testing is done manually by our Product team. That's a massive manual overhead that bottlenecks our product development. You'll help build our AI-powered QA automation pipeline, so every change, whether a person or an agent wrote it, is tested automatically before it reaches clients.

  • Strengthen the ECS architecture and complete the move with no disruption to clients.

  • Get the platform fully into code, with tenant isolation and least privilege designed in.

  • Put in place the monitoring and on-call foundations the team will build on.

How you'll work

You'll own this area rather than work through a ticket queue. You'll decide what to build and when it's good enough, write your decisions down so others can challenge them, and tell us when something isn't worth doing. You'll work closely with Product from the start of significant work, because the platform exists to serve clients and the engineers building for them.

You and I will work together every day. We'll shape the technical direction together and think through the hard calls, and you'll have a direct line to every decision that affects your work. I'll back your judgement, and I'll expect you to push back when you think I'm wrong.

This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to multiply the team: leading different areas at different times, and delivering through others as well as through your own work.

You'll probably enjoy this if

  • You'd rather build a platform properly than keep patching one.

  • You're product-minded. You've probably worked at a startup or scale-up, or even founded something yourself. Seeing your work out in the world, solving real problems, is what motivates you. You ask who a change is for before you ask how to build it.

  • You already work this way. Agents write much of your code, and your time goes on design, specs and judging the output. You've built AI tooling for yourself, and probably for others on your team.

  • You get satisfaction from making other engineers faster.

  • You're comfortable writing Terraform, an API endpoint and an answer to a client's security questionnaire in the same week.

  • You've been the person others come to with hard problems, and you've changed your mind publicly when the evidence said so.

This probably isn't for you if

  • You want a pure DevOps or SRE role.

  • You want to manage people right now. These opportunities might exist in the future, but for now we're small, lean and as flat as possible.

What you'll bring

Very few people match every line. If most of this describes you, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Deep, hands-on AWS. Several years running production workloads on ECS or EKS, with a solid grasp of IAM, networking and Lambda.

  • Infrastructure as code as a habit, with Terraform or CloudFormation, including bringing existing hand-built resources under code.

  • Scaling distributed systems. You've taken systems through real growth in load and data, and can teach others what you learnt.

  • Single-tenant SaaS experience. You know the isolation trade-offs and how to keep one client's data and credentials away from another's.

  • Security and compliance as part of engineering: least privilege, secrets management, and evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Production experience: on-call, incidents, post-mortems, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana or Honeycomb.

  • Full-stack product building. Senior TypeScript and Node.js, plus React, with a track record of shipping features end to end yourself, not just supporting the people who do.

  • Test automation and CI/CD. You've designed pipelines that test at the right levels and release safely, and you keep them fast and simple.

  • Tooling you've built for AI agents, not just used: agent configuration and orchestration, MCP servers or similar integrations, evals, automated review.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, React and MongoDB Atlas, running on AWS. CircleCI and Bitbucket. AI coding agents are part of everyday work. You don't need experience of all of these.

How we hire

We want to see how you actually work, so there are no whiteboard puzzles.

  1. Screening call with me (20 minutes)

  2. Competencies interview with me (30 minutes)

  3. Technical deep dive with a few of our engineers (90 minutes)

  4. Culture fit interview with our CEO, Hemal (30 minutes)

I'll be your main point of contact throughout. You'll know what to expect before each stage, and if we don't make an offer, I'll give you feedback.

raw.title: Programme Director
raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you'll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer
raw.description:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

description: About Infinite Lambda Infinite Lambda is a multi-award-winning Services-as-Software company specialising in enterprise data and AI transformation. We help leading enterprises create scalable AI capabilities that drive meaningful impact across the organisation. Our flagship product, Flowline, offers agentic professional services that accelerate the delivery of modern AI platforms in record time. Our award-winning partnerships with leaders like Snowflake, dbt Labs, Fivetran, Omni, Anthropic, and OpenAI enable us to cover the complete spectrum of building modern AI capabilities for our clients. We have had great success in France with companies like Macif, B for Bank, Alptis, and more, and are looking to build on that success. We are looking for ambitious people who want to be part of that journey. We are in it for the long run. This means nurturing sustainable growth, creating trustworthy technology, and empowering the people who use it. Locations & Work arrangements The role is remote, but you will be expected to travel occasionally to client sites, company meetings, and partner events. What you will be doing You will be responsible for winning and growing new logos in the enterprise segment. That includes: Work closely with our Leadership, Marketing & Branding, and Partnerships teams to fully capitalise on the pipeline that we are building together Build co-selling relationships with field teams at companies like Snowflake, Databricks, dbt Labs, Fivetran, Omni, OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX.ai Collaborate with Solutions Architects and FDEs to develop compelling proposals that add business value Drive a deal from prospect to SoW signed, and expand the account over time Represent Infinite Lambda at industry and partner events in France Manage a book of business of a minimum of €2 Million / annum What we're looking for Experience selling in the modern data and AI space is essential. You should be able to hold a credible conversation about data engineering, analytics and AI with technical buyers, and you will ideally have sold within or alongside the Snowflake, Databricks, or dbt ecosystems. Beyond that: 5+ years in sales, with at least 3 selling data, analytics, or AI services A track record of originating and closing six- and seven-figure consulting or services deals, and of hitting quota consistently Comfort selling to C-level and VP-level buyers, and translating technical capability into business outcomes Existing relationships in the Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran or dbt partner ecosystems are a real advantage Self-sufficiency. You will be operating with a lot of autonomy Willingness to travel for client meetings, partner events and conferences It would also help if you have worked at a data consultancy or systems integrator before, have depth in one of our core industries, or have sold GenAI or agentic AI engagements. You do not have to hit all of the above, but you need to be curious and motivated. What we offer EUR 140,000 - 180,000 OTE, with accelerators for overachieving performance State-of-the-art product, and award-winning services to help you land and grow accounts A genuine founding role in the French business, with influence over go-to-market strategy and future hiring Remote-first working with the option to work from an office if you prefer A people-first culture of mutual respect, where everyone has a great passion for their craft and is motivated to help their colleagues excel How to apply Send us your resume, along with a short note about the most complex data or AI deal you have closed and how you got it done. We read every application. Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. In France, as a final step in the hiring process, applicants are required to undergo a criminal background check with an accredited third-party screening company. Employment offers depend on the successful completion of this background check and the verification of all relevant information. We will request your explicit written consent before any screening begins. raw.title: Enterprise Sales & Strategy Associate (Internship)
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 32,000+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 700K members, and have reached €500M+ in ARR.

Our team of 600 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🤘 How we do it ?

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.


🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously


🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally

Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches


⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality

🚀 Your mission

Enterprise is our fastest growing market segment and represents a unique opportunity for Alan to become the health partner of millions of members by 2030.

Strengthening this segment is a high priority : we are doubling down to accelerate on the foundations set this year, increasing our reach, reinforcing our offer and positioning in order to support a growing number of larger companies in France.

As an Enterprise Sales & Strategy Associate, you will play a key role in helping us structure our approach to Very Large companies (> 3,000 employees). You will work closely with a team of 2 Senior Account Executives, 1 Business Developper and our Business Segment Lead, supporting them with closing deals and driving various growth-related projects.

You will be responsible for:

  • Deal support: partnering with Account Executives on their deal strategy, account mapping, meeting preparation and pitch presentations in order to tailor our approach.

  • Prospecting Support: Collaborating with Business Developers and Account Executives to build and deploy targeted prospecting strategies through account mapping, lead qualification, C-Level outreach, cold-calling and nurturing campaigns.

  • Tender management and RFP (Request for Purchase) Library: orchestrating tender answers with a dedicated taskforce (ops, marketing, pre-sales, sales, top management), with ownership of specific sections and content to build. Ideal to shape project management skills!

  • Networking & Brand Awareness: identifying events to participate to and personas to meet for our Founders and Senior Execs to make Alan more visible among decision-makers

  • Process Scaling: auditing existing sales processes (CRM, minutes of meeting automation, meeting prep framework….), identifying and implementing improvement areas

  • Go to Market Strategy: along with the crew lead or the Business Segment Lead, opportunity to dig deeper into a topic to crack (Unions market in France, brokers market…)

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • Are fully fluent in French & English (written and spoken)

  • Are analytical and think strategically : selling to very large accounts asks for the ability to map organizations to find the best interlocutor and have a clear picture of our positioning on the health insurance market

  • Have a strong business sense: bringing a disruptive vision on a conventional market such as health insurance is hard. It requires the ability to convince high level stakeholders and be able to outline our product's impact at a strategic level.

  • Are self-organized and autonomous: you are well-versed in missions requiring precision and reliability. You are able to manage a project from start to finish with minimal external assistance.

  • Communicate effectively: given the number of internal stakeholders with whom Very Large Sales interact on a daily basis, the ability to communicate with clarity is essential.

  • Display a growth mindset: you know how to ask for and receive feedback in order to grow and take the best of this experience to set you up for success in your early professional life.

  • Excel at teamwork: given the strategic implications of our Very Large business segment, volume and timeline of work, you have the ability to lead transversal initiatives towards a particular objective.

  • Show versatility: given the scope of work, you should be able to jump from one topic to another

  • Have a strong product and “Tech” sense: Alan is an innovative company offering the most high-end healthcare software on the market. In order to thrive in selling it, you need to enjoy deep diving in the technical dimension of the software industry.

Level considered for this position is between A0 and A2.

We're looking for someone to start in January 2027, ideally for a 6-month internship.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible office. Amazing office space at our HQ quai de Valmy

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Vos responsabilités principales Faire parler les données numériques Explorer smartphones, ordinateurs et autres supports numériques pour en extraire des informations essentielles aux enquêtes judiciaires. Garantir l'intégrité, la fiabilité et l'exploitabilité des données recueillies. Relever des défis techniques Identifier des composants défectueux et procéder à des réparations sur les ordinateurs et smartphones. Imaginer et mettre en œuvre des solutions adaptées aux situations les plus complexes. Développer les outils de demain Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de nos logiciels internes d'aide à l'analyse. Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour rendre les investigations plus efficaces et performantes. Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des outils existants. Innover au quotidien Concevoir des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux besoins spécifiques des enquêtes. Automatiser et optimiser les traitements pour faciliter l'exploitation des données numériques. Contribuer à la qualité des expertises Documenter les opérations techniques réalisées avec rigueur et précision. Participer à la rédaction et au contrôle qualité des rapports d'expertise. Apporter son expertise technique lors d'investigations judiciaires spécifiques. Avancer en équipe Collaborer étroitement avec les analystes et les développeurs pour répondre aux besoins du laboratoire. Partager ses connaissances, ses idées et ses découvertes techniques. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes et des savoir-faire de l'équipe. Compétences clés attendues Solides connaissances informatiques : Bonne maîtrise des systèmes d'exploitation, des systèmes de fichiers et du fonctionnement des ordinateurs et smartphones. Développement informatique full stack : Maîtrise de Python, SQL et des technologies web (JavaScript, HTML, CSS). Analyse et résolution de problèmes : Capacité à comprendre des situations techniques complexes, à identifier les difficultés et à trouver des solutions adaptées. Rigueur et fiabilité : Sens de la méthode, précision dans le travail et respect des procédures et des engagements. Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : Capacité à prendre en charge ses missions, à rechercher activement des solutions et à proposer des améliorations. Curiosité et esprit d'équipe : Goût pour les défis technologiques, volonté d'apprendre et capacité à collaborer et à partager ses connaissances. Profil recherché Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master 2 en informatique, idéalement avec une spécialisation en développement logiciel, systèmes informatiques ou cybersécurité. Polyvalence : Goût pour les missions variées, associant développement informatique, investigation technique et résolution de problèmes concrets. Qualités rédactionnelles : Excellente maîtrise du français écrit, orthographe irréprochable et capacité à rédiger des documents techniques clairs, précis et structurés. Autonomie et esprit d'équipe : Capacité à prendre des initiatives, à assumer ses responsabilités et à collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine. Sensibilité aux enjeux judiciaires : Intérêt marqué pour l'investigation numérique, la recherche de la vérité et les exigences de rigueur et de confidentialité propres au monde judiciaire. Maturité et discernement : Capacité à conserver une posture professionnelle face à des dossiers sensibles, pouvant comporter des contenus violents ou particulièrement choquants. Mobilité : Permis B requis et disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels ponctuels. Conditions particulières Les fonctions impliquent des exigences renforcées de confidentialité et d'intégrité. Une vérification du casier judiciaire pourra être effectuée. Lettre de motivation obligatoire : Nous accordons une réelle importance au sens de votre démarche. Au-delà de votre parcours technique, nous souhaitons comprendre ce qui vous attire dans notre métier et vous motive à rejoindre notre équipe. Ce que nous vous offrons Une rémunération attractive selon votre expérience et vos compétences, à laquelle s'ajoutent une prime de vacances et une prime annuelle. 6 semaines de congés payés pour favoriser un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle. Des horaires flexibles , offrant une souplesse d'organisation compatible avec les exigences de nos missions. Des avantages sociaux : tickets restaurant et mutuelle prise en charge à 60 % par l'entreprise. Un cadre de travail privilégié , au cœur des montagnes et aux portes de Grenoble, facilement accessible grâce à deux lignes de transports en commun et à la proximité d'un grand axe routier. Une salle de restauration est également à votre disposition. Une équipe à taille humaine , favorisant la proximité, l'entraide, l'autonomie et le partage des connaissances. Des missions variées et stimulantes , avec l'opportunité de développer vos compétences, de relever des défis techniques et de contribuer concrètement aux enquêtes judiciaires. À noter : En raison de la nature de nos activités et de la manipulation de données sensibles, le poste s'exerce exclusivement sur site, sans possibilité de télétravail. raw.description:
What is Finary?

We are on a mission to give power back to investors. Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. We're changing that by building the AI-powered one-stop shop for investing, where you can track your assets, manage your budget, invest, and learn. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use.

Why now?

A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise).

In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

The opportunity

More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.

Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory, and now control. Each role covers every licence. You'll be the one who checks that what we say we do is what we actually do.

What you'll do

  • Execute the permanent control plan: about 40 controls a year, 3 to 5 days each, across all four licences.

  • Design each test and run it yourself: population, sampling, test steps, evidence.

  • Write findings and recommendations based on evidence, and review them with the teams concerned, taking their remarks into account.

  • Improve the control plan: keep regulatory references up to date, raise the quality of each control, and run spot controls, validated by the Head of Compliance, when the compliance team detects a risk to prioritise.

  • Follow every recommendation until it is closed: re-test, and escalate what is overdue.

  • Automate as much as possible: with data and AI tools, from testing full populations to keeping the control library current, so your time goes to judgement.

  • Control only, by design: no operational tasks. Your variable pay depends only on the quality of your controls and how much of the plan is executed.

What we're looking for

  • You've spent 6+ years in permanent control, regulatory consulting or inspection in financial services, and you executed the controls yourself.

  • Your working papers have been through a regulator inspection or a periodic control (internal audit).

  • You've tested controls in at least two types of licensed institution: crypto-asset service provider, investment firm, payment or e-money institution, insurance intermediary. Investment firm experience is not required.

  • You test with data and AI tools, and you've already automated parts of your control work. This is a must, not a plus.

  • You base findings on evidence, and you take the business's remarks into account when reviewing them.

  • You plan and deliver on your own, following the control plan and risk map: there is no control framework team around you yet.

  • Native-level French and professional English.

This role is not for you if you'd rather run operations, you need a GRC tool and a team before you can start, or you see controls as boxes to tick.

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: executing controls and getting them closed.

What we offer

  • 65K to 80K EUR total package (fixed + variable), depending on level, plus BSPCE

  • Reporting to the Head of Compliance, in a team of five

  • Based in Paris: on site at least 2 days a week (3 days remote maximum). Permanent contract (CDI), start in Q1 2027

  • MacBook Pro and every AI subscription you need

  • Health coverage with Alan, and a learning budget

How we work

  • Regulated by choice: we chose the licences years before they became mandatory

  • English is our operating language; your regulatory work will be in French

  • Our process: screen with our talent team (45 min), take-home case (about 3h), case debrief with the Head of Compliance, team meeting, founder meeting. About three weeks end to end.

Interviews

Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call.

Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use.

Why now?

A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise).

In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

Context: where you'd have impact

Finary (YC W21, 25M€ Series B) is building the leading wealth management platform in Europe. Some numbers:

  • 1M+ users on the platform

  • A YouTube channel with 850k+ subscribers and 5-10M monthly views, our main acquisition engine

  • Finary One, our private offering for 1M€+ portfolios, growing fast

Our #1 growth challenge: converting our 1M+ users into paying subscribers to drive revenue.

Our #2: feeding qualified leads to Finary One through content and growth work. The growth team today is 2 people plus AI agents doing the work of many more.

Everything you ship moves a metric someone looks at weekly.

Nothing you do will be "intern work" that sits in a drawer.

About the role

You will join as a Growth Intern with a hybrid scope: hands-on growth execution across channels, plus data and automation work that makes the whole team faster. The team is AI-native: we automate everything that can be automated and spend our time on what moves the needle. This is not a "watch and learn" internship. You ship from week 1.

Missions

Growth execution

  • Create and manage content across platforms (YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok)

  • Support SEO and website work: blog articles, optimization, keyword research

  • Build and optimize CRM campaigns to convert free users into subscribers

  • Assist on paid marketing: campaign setup, monitoring, optimization

  • Support Finary One lead generation, partnerships, PR, and brand initiatives

Data & automation

  • Build dashboards and reports to monitor performance across channels, including the YouTube-to-signup funnel

  • Design and implement automations to eliminate repetitive marketing and data workflows

  • Leverage AI tools extensively: agents, workflows, analysis, reporting

  • Bring data-driven recommendations to editorial and marketing meetings

What we look for


✅ Must-haves

  • AI-first mindset: uses AI daily to solve problems and accelerate work, beyond simple chat prompts

  • High agency: acts without waiting for permission and drives tasks to completion

  • Analytical rigor: structures problems, defines metrics, extracts clear insights from noisy data

  • Strong written communication in French and English

  • Genuine interest in personal finance and Finary's mission


✨ Nice to have

  • Python or no-code automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier)

  • Familiarity with marketing analytics tools

  • A personal project that shows initiative

🚫 Dealbreakers

  • Low agency

  • Tool-first thinking without judgment

  • No interest in finance

Why Finary now

  • Series B momentum, building the #1 wealth management platform in Europe

  • Full-stack growth exposure, not siloed: acquisition, conversion, retention, lead gen

  • A-player team with high standards and a fast learning curve

  • Real ownership and tangible outcomes shipped in weeks, not months

description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables. GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets. Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires. Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source. Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont : ·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature. ·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration. ·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques. ·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé. ·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations. ·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion. ·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.   CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES : Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.   Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.   PROFIL RECHERCHE : ·       Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? : ·       cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha ·       49 jours de congés par an ·       restauration administrative sur place ·       aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail ·       action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)   INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES : Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 18 mois À usage interne : Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi Date limite de candidature : 26/11/2026 Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/01/2027 La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines Télécom Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de catégorie A de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles Contacts : o   Sur le contenu du poste : F. title: Facility Maintenance Engineer H/F
description: 📍 IDF | Data Center | CDI | Astreinte 1 semaine sur 4 Rejoignez un environnement technique critique en pleine croissance Mon client accompagne ses clients dans l'hébergement et l'exploitation d'infrastructures critiques au cœur de l'économie numérique. Dans le cadre du développement de son site en pleine croissance et amené à s'étendre régulièrement, mon client renforce son équipe Facility et recherche un(e) Facility Maintenance Engineer . Création de poste, vous rejoindrez une équipe Facility à taille humaine et aurez un rôle central dans le pilotage technique des infrastructures et des prestataires , avec une véritable responsabilité sur la qualité des opérations et la continuité de service. Vous n'êtes pas nécessairement celui ou celle qui intervient directement sur les équipements : votre valeur réside dans votre capacité à comprendre les installations, analyser les problématiques, identifier les interactions entre les différents systèmes et challenger les prestataires sur leurs interventions . Vos missions Rattaché(e) au Responsable de site, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et assurez leur maintien en conditions opérationnelles. Votre périmètre couvre notamment les infrastructures : électriques HT/BT et leurs systèmes de secours ; climatiques / CVC ; protection incendie ; infrastructures techniques associées. Vous devez être capable d'appréhender l'ensemble du système et les interactions entre les différentes infrastructures , afin d'anticiper les impacts d'une intervention ou d'un incident sur la continuité de service. Vos principales missions 1- Piloter la maintenance et les prestataires Votre rôle principal consiste à assurer le pilotage technique des contrats et des prestataires de maintenance . À ce titre, vous : pilotez les contrats de maintenance et suivez les engagements associés ; coordonnez et challengez les prestataires techniques ; préparez et animez les réunions de suivi, notamment les réunions hebdomadaires; contrôlez la qualité des interventions et leur conformité aux procédures ; analysez les modes opératoires proposés par les prestataires et êtes capable de les challenger lorsque nécessaire ; suivez les KPI techniques et les indicateurs de performance ; veillez au respect du planning de maintenance et des exigences opérationnelles. Vous êtes un(e) interlocuteur(rice) technique capable de faire le lien entre les besoins du site et les entreprises intervenantes . 2- Analyser les incidents et les problématiques techniques L'analyse est une dimension essentielle du poste. Lorsqu'une problématique survient, vous êtes capable de : comprendre la situation dans sa globalité ; analyser les causes et les interactions entre les différentes infrastructures ; évaluer les impacts potentiels sur le fonctionnement du Data Center ; orienter le prestataire vers les actions adaptées ; challenger une analyse ou un mode opératoire lorsque celui-ci n'est pas suffisamment robuste ; suivre les actions correctives jusqu'à leur résolution ; contribuer aux retours d'expérience et à l'amélioration des pratiques. Vous devez donc être capable de prendre du recul sur une problématique technique et de raisonner en système , plutôt que de vous limiter à un équipement isolé. 3- Accompagner le développement du site Le site connaît une forte croissance, avec de nouveaux bâtiments amenés à être développés régulièrement. Dans ce contexte, vous participez notamment à : l'intégration des nouvelles infrastructures ; l'identification et le suivi des problématiques techniques ; la coordination des différents interlocuteurs ; l'accompagnement des projets et des évolutions du site ; l'amélioration continue des installations et des méthodes d'exploitation. Votre rôle sera notamment de fluidifier les interfaces et de faire émerger les sujets nécessitant une action ou un arbitrage. 4- Travailler en transverse Vous évoluez dans un environnement où les interactions sont nombreuses. Vous travaillerez notamment avec : le Responsable de site ; l'équipe Facility ; les prestataires de maintenance ; les équipes projets ; les fonctions transverses ; les équipes en charge de l'ISO et de l'énergie ; les équipes intervenant dans les audits, visites et relations clients. 5 - La capacité à travailler en équipe et à partager un objectif commun est donc essentielle. Vous contribuerez également au suivi des sujets liés à la performance énergétique, aux exigences ISO et aux différents audits du site. L'environnement de travail Vous rejoindrez une équipe Facility actuellement composée de 3 personnes , au sein d'une organisation à taille humaine et soudée. Il s'agit d'une création de poste , destinée à accompagner la croissance du site et à renforcer les ressources dédiées au pilotage technique. L'environnement est dynamique : certains process sont encore en cours de structuration, notamment autour de la gestion des incidents. Nous recherchons donc une personne capable de s'appuyer sur les procédures existantes tout en sachant évoluer dans des situations qui ne sont pas toujours parfaitement définies , avec pragmatisme et discernement. Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez impérativement d'une expérience dans : un environnement critique ; les infrastructures techniques ; la maintenance industrielle . Vous possédez un bagage technique suffisamment large pour comprendre les environnements électriques, climatiques/CVC et de protection incendie , ainsi que les systèmes de secours associés. Vous n'avez pas nécessairement vocation à intervenir directement sur les équipements : vous êtes avant tout capable de comprendre techniquement les installations et de piloter ceux qui interviennent dessus . Les qualités recherchées Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons une personne : méthodique , capable de structurer son analyse et son action ; dotée d'un fort esprit d'analyse , notamment face à des problématiques complexes ; avec un véritable esprit d'équipe ; capable de challenger des prestataires avec diplomatie mais fermeté ; à l'aise dans un environnement où les situations peuvent parfois manquer de cadre ; capable de prendre du recul et de comprendre les interactions entre les différents systèmes. capacité à exploiter les outils de supervision, de reporting, de suivi énergétique et les données techniques pour détecter les dérives et optimiser la performance. capacité à rédiger, challenger les procédures SOP MOP EOP et les valider à son niveau de périmètre Votre capacité à analyser une situation, comprendre ses impacts et faire passer le bon message au bon interlocuteur sera déterminante dans votre réussite. Avantages Bonus /an : 2 mois de salaire si atteint Indemnité astreinte : 505€ / semaine d'astreinte (fréquence 1S/mois environ) + paiement des heures supplémentaires en cas d'intervention Indemnité forfait déplacement / an : 2512€ Indemnité télétravail / an : 175€ Participation : 1 mois et demi de salaire (voire plus) Cadre Astreinte Ce poste comprend une astreinte dédiée au site à raison d'une semaine sur quatre . Dans ce cadre, vous pourrez être sollicité(e) en soirée, le week-end ou en dehors des horaires habituels afin de contribuer à la continuité de fonctionnement du Data Center. Pourquoi rejoindre ce poste ? Ce poste offre l'opportunité de rejoindre un site Data Center en pleine croissance , dans un environnement technique particulièrement exigeant. Vous aurez un rôle central dans la montée en puissance du site, avec la possibilité de contribuer à la structuration des pratiques, au développement des infrastructures et à l'amélioration continue des opérations. C'est également l'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe soudée , qui souhaite aujourd'hui renforcer ses compétences et apporter un véritable "sang neuf" dans son organisation. description: Rejoignez l’aventure Joivy : L’art de vivre (et de travailler) à l’européenne ! Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open . Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché : Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide. Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie). Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis. Tu joueras un rôle clé au cœur de la qualité de notre service client. Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe experte et bienveillante, dans un contexte de structuration et de montée en puissance de notre nouveau pôle Quality and Process.   Missions : Pilotage au quotidien : planifier l'ensemble des prestations dans le CRM pour garantir une couverture parfaite du parc. Logistique terrain : organiser les tournées des prestataires (clés et accès) en présentiel à Paris et à distance pour les autres régions. Contrôle qualité : veiller à l'excellence des prestations réalisées et résoudre rapidement les imprévus du terrain. Management & optimisation : animer le réseau de prestataires et réinventer nos processus d'assignation pour gagner en efficacité. Missions transversales (Projets ménage & check-out) : Suivi financier : contrôler la conformité des factures prestataires et fluidifier le circuit de validation pour le pôle ménage. Ton profil Tu prépares un diplôme en école d'immobilier, d'hôtellerie ou en gestion de projet. Tu fais preuve d'une rigueur absolue et d'un grand sens du détail pour garantir la qualité de chaque intervention. Tu possèdes une excellente aisance relationnelle pour échanger efficacement avec nos prestataires sur le terrain. Tu es très à l'aise avec les outils digitaux et maîtrises les bases d'Excel. Tu maîtrises le français à l'oral comme à l'écrit (la maîtrise de l'anglais est un vrai plus). Pour que ton expérience chez Joivy France soit aussi enrichissante que stimulante, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour t'offrir un cadre de travail privilégié : Un stage rémunéré qui reconnaît ton engagement et ta contribution réelle à nos succès. Intègre une communauté unie, motivée et collaborative, où l'entraide est le moteur de chaque défi relevé. Entre nos afterworks mémorables, nos compétitions de tir au Nerf légendaires et nos petits-déjeuners conviviaux chaque mardi, la cohésion est notre priorité. Profite de 2 jours de télétravail par semaine (au bout de trois mois d’ancienneté) pour concilier au mieux tes missions et ta vie personnelle. Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), et la prise en charge à 50% de ton abonnement de transport. L'accès exclusif aux dad jokes incontournables de notre collègue Loeiz, garanties 100% authentiques pour illuminer tes journées.
